Question 1
?

Let f(x) be a function with f(4)=1,f′(4)=−1,f″(4)=−2 and f‴(4)=12. Which of the following is the third-degree Taylor polynomial for f(x) about x=4?

a
1−(x−4)−(x−4)2+2(x−4)3
b
1−(x+4)−2(x+4)2+12(x+4)3
c
1−(x−4)−(x−4)2+(x−4)3
d
1−(x−4)−2(x−4)2+12(x−4)3
e
1−(x+4)−2(x+4)2+2(x+4)3
Submit
